usagePrompt:
Privy on-ramp for Orderly Network DEXes that use Privy for wallet auth. Adds a "Buy USDC" row to the shared "Privy Wallet" menu (from @pacrypto55/wallet-menu) that lets a connected user fund their Privy embedded wallet via Privy's own fundWallet() flow.

Before installing: this calls Privy's fundWallet(), which requires a funding provider (e.g. MoonPay) to be connected under Configuration -> Funding in the Privy Dashboard for your App ID - a server-side, per-App setting that no client-side config can turn on. If it isn't set up, the plugin still installs and renders correctly; clicking "Buy USDC" shows a toast explaining exactly this instead of failing silently.

Install:
1. npm install @pacrypto55/privy-onramp (peer deps: react, react-dom, @privy-io/react-auth ^2.x, @orderly.network/plugin-core and ui ^3.1.x, and @pacrypto55/wallet-menu, all installed automatically).
2. Pass registerPrivyOnrampPlugin() in the plugins array of your OrderlyAppProvider. That's it - it defensively registers the shared wallet-menu host too, so installing this plugin alone is enough even without also installing @pacrypto55/privy-2fa or registering @pacrypto55/wallet-menu yourself.

Options: label (row text, default "Buy USDC") and fundWalletConfig (forwarded as-is to Privy's fundWallet(), default { asset: "USDC", amount: "10" }).
